title: 第606章 前往中心大陆第605章 沐暮的遭遇
slug: 修仙所有人都以为她背景很强
lines: 巫未央有点唏嘘，同时心底好奇白风这头白虎究竟是有什么特别，引起了虎妖的注意。
“白风...是你在鸿蒙大陆契约的妖兽吧。”巫未央有点迟疑，想起驭兽宗宗主羽寒真君的契约兽，那可是妖族长大的妖。
沐暮眼底哀伤，“我遇到它时，它确实是一头不谙世事，只知道吃的妖兽，虽然有点聪明，但也没聪明多少。”
身为主人，沐暮这个评价属实是有点犀利了，白风听到了定然是闹的。
巫未央摇摇头，“现在的情况，白风定然是有什么特殊的，你与它有契约，能感受到它的情况吗？”
沐暮并指抵在额头上，银白虎纹一闪而过，他的神情一瞬间更加低落了，“本应能感应到它所在，现在契约好像被什么遮住了，不过契约还在，它应该没有生命危险。”
这也是沐暮清醒过后能定心坐在这里的原因，不然他早疯了。
“我要去找它，抱歉。”
沐暮沉沉说了一句，他现在心里只有白虎，其他的，什么都不重要了。
“那就养好伤。”巫未央没有多说，她无法感同身受沐暮与白虎之间的羁绊，但她向来尊重其他人的选择。
沐暮呆愣片刻，“我以为你们青云宗的人，都要劝人以天下为重。”
说完，他好像想起来什么，看了巫未央一眼，即使没说出口，巫未央也知道他的意思，她虽然进入宗门时只有十四，可是对于从小接受宗门教育的人还是不一样。
不过巫未央认真告诉他，“即使是季师兄，他也不会这样劝你。”
巫未央和季青衣相处得少一些，可是从楚安宁身上能窥见，青云宗弟子绝不是这样的人，他们确实以天下为重，但从不忽视身边人，更不会要求其他人这样做。
“对不起，是我误会了。”沐暮道歉，六大宗弟子的关系此前确实不太亲密，对彼此都有着不少刻板的印象。
巫未央：“快养伤吧。”
她嘱咐完，接过冬酿前肢递来的蝎子串，瞧了上面的黑灰一眼后，趁着冬酿不备，将蝎子串丢到身后的山丘背面。
“我来吧。”巫未央相当自然地接过其他蝎子串，冬酿红彤彤的大眼睛盯了她一会，好像有点诧异为什么主人吃得这么快，但是冬酿不吃肉，它不知道吃肉要多少时间。
虽然烤蝎子也很有意思，但冬酿许久不活动，对外面的世界也有兴趣，扇着小翅膀飞远了。
沐暮看着她们的互动，心里闷闷的，对冬酿身上浅浅一层的皮毛都不感到奇怪了，脑海里闪现着他与白风相处的趣事。
巫未央可不知道自己和冬酿还刺痛了沐暮，看见沐暮发愣一会后便陷入修炼，于是放心烤蝎子。
她不想吃，单纯想烤。
半个月后，一只体型硕大圆滚的，披着红袍的毒蜂穿过层层风沙，背上有着三道人影。
巫未央，沐暮，以及贰号傀儡。
冬酿是不愿意干活的，但是巫未央发现它真正的飞行速度确实快，比起自己来说，一点也不慢。
所以最初便让它带着沐暮这个伤员，直到最后彻底沦为飞行契约兽。
好在三个人的重量对于冬酿来说根本不算什么，拆解一件法衣给冬酿做了袍子之后，它更愿意了。
沐暮一路上见多巫未央对冬酿的黑心举动，愣是反思自己是不是对白风太宠溺了，可如果白风能够回到他身边，就是再宠溺也不为过。
他时不时陷入黯然失神的状态，巫未央已经见惯了，没有一丝安慰的念头，只是看着远处一抹蓝说道，“快要出海了。”
content_en:
Wu Weiyang was a little embarrassed, and at the same time, she was curious about what was so special about Bai Feng, a white tiger, that attracted the tiger demon's attention.
"Baifeng...is the monster you contracted in Hongmeng Continent, right?" Wu Weiyang hesitated a little, remembering the contracted beast of Zhenjun Yu Han, the leader of the Beast Taming Sect, which was a monster that grew up in the monster clan.
Mu Mu's eyes were filled with sadness, "When I met it, it was indeed a monster that didn't know much about the world and only knew how to eat. Although it was a bit smart, it wasn't much smarter."
As the master, Mu Mu's comment was indeed a bit sharp. Bai Feng must have made a fuss when he heard it.
Wu Weiyang shook his head, "Baifeng must have something special about the current situation. You have a contract with it, can you feel its situation?"
Mu Mu put his fingers on his forehead, silver tiger stripes flashed past, and his expression became even lower for a moment, "I should have been able to sense its location, but now the contract seems to be covered by something, but the contract is still there, and it should not be life-threatening."
This is also the reason why Mu Mu can calmly sit here after he wakes up, otherwise he would have gone crazy.
"I'm going to find it, sorry."
Mu Mu said solemnly that he only had Bai Hu in his heart now, and nothing else mattered.
"Then heal your wounds." Wu Weiyang didn't say much. She couldn't empathize with the bond between Mu Mu and Bai Hu, but she always respected other people's choices.
Mu Mu was stunned for a moment, "I thought that you, the Qingyun Sect, would advise people to put the world first."
After saying that, he seemed to remember something and glanced at Wu Weiyang. Even if he didn't say it, Wu Weiyang knew what he meant. Although she was only fourteen when she entered the sect, it was still different for someone who had received sect education since childhood.
But Wu Weiyang told him seriously, "Even Senior Brother Ji would not advise you like this."
Wu Weiyang and Ji Qingyi get along less, but from Chu Anning, it can be seen that Qingyun Sect disciples are definitely not such people. They do put the world first, but they never ignore the people around them, let alone ask others to do so.
"I'm sorry, I misunderstood." Mu Mu apologized. The relationship between the six major disciples was indeed not close before, and they all had many stereotypes about each other.
Wu Weiyang: "Recuperate quickly."
After she finished her instructions, she took the scorpion skewer from Dong Niang's forelimb, glanced at the black ash on it, and threw the scorpion skewer onto the back of the hill behind her before Dong Niang was prepared.
"I'll do it." Wu Weiyang took the other scorpion skewers quite naturally. Dong Niang's big red eyes stared at her for a while, as if she was a little surprised why the owner ate so fast. But Dong Niang doesn't eat meat, so it doesn't know how long it takes to eat meat.
Although roasting scorpions is also very interesting, Dong Niang has been inactive for a long time and is also interested in the outside world. He flaps his little wings and flies away.
Mu Mu felt depressed as he watched their interaction. He was no longer surprised by the light fur on Dong Niang's body. Interesting stories about him and Baifeng's interactions flashed in his mind.
Wu Weiyang didn't know that she and Dong Niang had stung Mu Mu. Seeing that Mu Mu was in a daze for a while and then fell into practice, he was relieved to roast the scorpion.
She didn't want to eat it, she just wanted to bake it.
Half a month later, a large, round, red-robed poisonous bee walked through the layers of windy sand, with three figures on its back.
Wu Weiyang, Mu Mu, and Puppet No. 2.
Dong Niang was unwilling to work, but Wu Weiyang discovered that its real flying speed was indeed fast, and it was not slower at all compared to him.
Therefore, he initially let him carry the injured Mu Mu until he was completely reduced to a flying contracted beast.
Fortunately, the weight of three people was nothing to Dong Niang. After dismantling a cassock and making a robe for Dong Niang, it became more willing.
Along the way, Mu Mu saw Duo Wu Weiyang's evil behavior towards Dong Niang, and was stunned to reflect on whether he was too doting on Bai Feng, but if Bai Feng could come back to him, no amount of doting would be too much.
He fell into a state of gloominess from time to time. Wu Weiyang was used to it. Without any thought of comfort, he just looked at a flash of blue in the distance and said, "We are about to go to sea."
